Author: Manmeet Pritam Singh Arora

 Through: Mr. Sunil Dalal, Sr

 ve
 Deepa Devi & Ors. 
 Through: 
 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Manmeet Pritam Singh Arora
 Order
% 01.07.2024 I.A. 31787/2024 (for exemption)
1. Plaintiff shall file legible and clearer copies of exempted documents, compliant with practice rules within two weeks. 
2. The application for exemption is allowed, subject to the plaintiff granting inspection of the documents filed, as and when required to do so, or filing the original documents at the stage of admission/denial.
3. The application stands disposed of. 
CS(OS) 499/2024 4. The plaint be registered as a suit. Mr. Neel Mason, learned counsel waives formal service of summons on behalf of defendant no. 4.
5. Summons be issued to defendant nos. 1 and 2 by all permissible This is a digitally signed order.

1 The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 01/07/2024 at 21:14:33 modes on filing of process fee. Affidavit of service be filed within two weeks. Dasti in addition. 
6. The summons shall indicate that the written statement(s) must be filed within 30 days from the date of receipt of the summons. The defendant nos. 1 and 2 shall also file affidavits of admission/denial of the documents filed by the plaintiff, failing which the written statement(s) shall not be taken on record. 
7. The plaintiff is at liberty to file replication(s) thereto within 15 days after filing of the written statements. The replication(s) shall be accompanied by affidavits of admission/denial in respect of the documents filed by the defendant nos. 1 and 2, failing which the replication(s) shall not be taken on record. 
8. It is hereby directed that any unjustified denial of documents may lead to an order of costs against the concerned party. 
9. Any party seeking inspection of documents may do so in accordance with the Delhi High Court (Original Side) Rules, 2018. 
10. Learned counsel for the plaintiff states that an advance service of the suit record was served on defendant nos. 1 and 2 and thereafter, a counsel who identified himself as Mr. Rajat Makan had telephonically contacted him to obtain certain documents, which were duly furnished to him by the plaintiff. However, none appears on behalf of the said defendants today. The plaintiff is granted liberty in addition to serve the summons through Mr. Rajat Makan on his mobile number. 
11. List before the Court on 04thJuly, 2024.
I.A. 31786/2024 (application under Order XXVI Rules 10A of the CPC)
12. Learned senior counsel for the plaintiff states that the present This is a digitally signed order. 
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 01/07/2024 at 21:14:33 application has been filed seeking forensic examination of the Amul Vanilla ice cream tub bearing batch no. MKN 106 [packed on 15.04.2024] showed by defendant nos. 1 and 2 in their social media posts. 12.1. He states that such forensic examination can be conducted by any Government laboratory including the laboratories authorized by Food Safety and Standards Authority of India ('FSSAI'). He states that such forensic examination would effectively determine the date of the demise of the Centipede alleged to have been found in the ice cream tub, which would assist in ascertaining whether a Centipede was indeed present in the said ice cream tub before it was sealed and packed in the premises of the plaintiff. 
13. Issue notice to defendant nos. 1 and 2 through all permissible modes for the date fixed.

15. List on 04thJuly, 2024.
I.A. 31785/2024 (application under Order XXXIX Rules 1 and 2 of the CPC)
16. Issue notice to defendant nos. 1 and 2 through all permissible modes for the date fixed. 
17. Reply to the application be filed before the next date of hearing. 
18. List on 04thJuly, 2024.
